name: Zezhou Cheng
title: Assistant Professor
fitReason: Stereo4DWalker (IROS2026) learns geometry-aware navigation from Internet stereo walking videos using depth, dense tracking and transformer attention. It supplies a concrete embodied transfer/deployment project within a self-supervised and3D vision laboratory.

physicalEvidence.summary: The September14,2026 primary revision evaluates real navigation on a Clearpath Jackal J100 with stereo-camera observations. GPU-server inference streams waypoints through FastAPI to a ROS2 velocity controller. There are14 trials per forward/left/right case,42 per method; collisions causing interruption count as failures. Teleoperated expert data use Jackal/Ouster LiDAR/ZED2i.

shortVisit.summary: The live university-hosted lab contact page explicitly accepts interest from visiting students and research interns at external institutions through its form, separate from UVA students and degree applicants. The homepage also invites research interns by email/CV or form. No duration, specific degree eligibility or summer2027 availability is stated.
